title: Impossible Travel and Suspicious OAuth Consent
summary: A finance user reported an unexpected MFA prompt. Your job is to investigate recent sign-ins, cloud activity, and device network events to identify whether an account was abused and what was touched.
objectives: Identify the risky IP and user
Connect the sign-in to OAuth consent and file access
Name the affected user, device, IP, and file
explanation: Mia Chen had a normal Seattle sign-in followed nine minutes later by a successful sign-in from an anonymizing hosting provider in Amsterdam. The same session consented to a suspicious OAuth app named Invoice Reader Pro, then accessed a payroll spreadsheet from SharePoint. FIN-LAP-014 later connected to the same IP, suggesting token or browser session abuse from that endpoint.

tables.name: SigninLogs
tables.description: Microsoft Entra sign-in events for users and applications.

tables.name: CloudAppEvents
tables.description: Microsoft Defender for Cloud Apps activity records.

tables.name: DeviceNetworkEvents
tables.description: Defender for Endpoint network connections from managed devices.

steps.question: Find successful high-risk sign-ins in SigninLogs. Which user and IP stand out?
steps.expectedKql:
SigninLogs
| where ResultType == 0 and RiskLevelDuringSignIn == "high"
| project TimeGenerated, UserPrincipalName, IPAddress, Location, AppDisplayName
steps.hint: Filter SigninLogs to successful results and the high risk level, then project the identity and network fields.
steps.explanation: The suspicious sign-ins belong to mia.chen@contoso.com from 185.225.69.44 in Amsterdam.

steps.question: Use the cloud activity table to find what happened from the suspicious IP after the sign-in.
steps.expectedKql:
CloudAppEvents
| where IPAddress == "185.225.69.44"
| project TimeGenerated, AccountUpn, Application, ActionType, ObjectName, RawEventData
steps.hint: Pivot from the suspicious IP into CloudAppEvents and keep action and object columns visible.
steps.explanation: The IP consented to Invoice Reader Pro and downloaded Q4_Payroll_Adjustments.xlsx.

steps.question: Identify the managed device that connected to the suspicious IP.
steps.expectedKql:
DeviceNetworkEvents
| where RemoteIP == "185.225.69.44"
| project TimeGenerated, DeviceName, InitiatingProcessAccountUpn, RemoteIP, InitiatingProcessFileName
steps.hint: In endpoint network data, destination IPs are stored as RemoteIP.
steps.explanation: FIN-LAP-014 connected to the same IP using Edge under Mia's account.

steps.question: Write a final summary query that lists the affected user, IP, OAuth app, and downloaded file from cloud events.
steps.expectedKql:
CloudAppEvents
| where AccountUpn == "mia.chen@contoso.com" and IPAddress == "185.225.69.44"
| summarize Actions=make_set(ActionType), Objects=make_set(ObjectName) by AccountUpn, IPAddress
steps.hint: Summarize CloudAppEvents by the account and IP, collecting action and object names.
steps.explanation: The summary ties Mia, the suspicious IP, Invoice Reader Pro, and the payroll spreadsheet together.
